001package io.github.ai4ci.config.execution;
002
003import java.io.Serializable;
004
005import org.immutables.value.Value;
006
007import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.annotation.JsonDeserialize;
008import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.annotation.JsonSerialize;
009
010import io.github.ai4ci.Data.Partial;
011import io.github.ai4ci.config.Scale;
012import io.github.ai4ci.functions.FixedValueFunction;
013import io.github.ai4ci.functions.ImmutableEmpiricalFunction;
014import io.github.ai4ci.functions.ImmutableMathematicalFunction;
015import io.github.ai4ci.functions.LinkFunction;
016import io.github.ai4ci.functions.SimpleFunction;
017
018/**
019 * Age-based adjustment values used to modify baseline model parameters.
020 *
021 * <p>
022 * Main purpose: provide a small set of interfaces that describe how various
023 * model parameters may be adjusted by demographic strata (for example age).
024 * Implementations supply distribution-like or numeric transforms that are
025 * consulted by initialisers and model code to produce age-dependent values.
026 *
027 * <p>
028 * Downstream uses: referenced by
029 * {@link io.github.ai4ci.config.execution.ExecutionConfiguration}, in-host
030 * configuration types such as
031 * {@link io.github.ai4ci.config.inhost.PhenomenologicalModel} and
032 * {@link io.github.ai4ci.config.inhost.MarkovStateModel}, and by initialisers
033 * in {@link io.github.ai4ci.flow.builders.DefaultPersonInitialiser}.
034 *
035 * @author Rob Challen
036 */
037@SuppressWarnings("immutable")
038public interface DemographicAdjustment {
039
040        /**
041         * A combined partial adjustment usable for different configuration facets.
042         *
043         * This immutable partial implements the execution, phenomenological and
044         * markov facets so a single object may be applied where a complete set of
045         * age-dependent adjustments is required.
046         */
047        @Value.Immutable
048        @Partial
049        @JsonSerialize(as = PartialDemographicAdjustment.class)
050        @JsonDeserialize(as = PartialDemographicAdjustment.class)
051        @SuppressWarnings("immutable")
052        public interface _PartialDemographicAdjustment extends
053                        DemographicAdjustment.Execution<SimpleFunction, SimpleFunction>,
054                        DemographicAdjustment.Phenomenological<SimpleFunction, SimpleFunction>,
055                        DemographicAdjustment.Markov<SimpleFunction, SimpleFunction>,
056                        Serializable {
057                // Convenience self reference used by the Immutables builder API.
058                /**
059                 * Convenience self reference used by the Immutables builder API.
060                 *
061                 * @return this instance
062                 */
063                default _PartialDemographicAdjustment self() {
064                        return this;
065                }
066        }
067
068        /**
069         * Age dependent values in the general execution configuration.
070         *
071         * <p>
072         * Implementations supply either distribution-like objects or numeric
073         * transforms that are interpreted by execution code to produce age-specific
074         * parameters such as case rates and contact odds.
075         *
076         * @param <DIST>    the type used to represent distribution-like adjustments
077         *                  (for example a function or empirical distribution)
078         * @param <NUMERIC> the type used to represent numeric adjustments (for
079         *                  example a simple scalar or a function that produces a
080         *                  numeric value)
081         */
082        @SuppressWarnings("immutable")
083        public interface Execution<DIST, NUMERIC> {
084                /**
085                 * A function returning an age dependent odds ratio adjusting baseline app
086                 * use probability (digital contact tracing uptake).
087                 *
088                 * @return a distribution-like object representing app use probability
089                 */
090                @Scale(Scale.ScaleType.ODDS)
091                DIST getAppUseProbability();
092
093                /**
094                 * A function returning an age dependent odds ratio adjusting baseline
095                 * adjusting the asymptomatic fraction by age group.
096                 *
097                 * @return A function returning an odds ratio adjusting the asymptomatic
098                 *         fraction by age group.
099                 */
100                @Scale(Scale.ScaleType.ODDS)
101                NUMERIC getAsymptomaticFraction();
102
103                /**
104                 * A function returning an age dependent odds ratio adjusting baseline
105                 * Case fatality rate by age group.
106                 *
107                 * @return A function returning an age dependent odds ratio adjusting
108                 *         baseline fatality rate
109                 */
110                @Scale(Scale.ScaleType.ODDS)
111                NUMERIC getCaseFatalityRate();
112
113                /**
114                 * A function returning an age dependent odds ratio adjusting baseline
115                 * Case hospitalisation rate by age group.
116                 *
117                 * @return A function returning an age dependent odds ratio adjusting
118                 *         baseline hospitalisation rate
119                 */
120                @Scale(Scale.ScaleType.ODDS)
121                NUMERIC getCaseHospitalisationRate();
122
123                /**
124                 * A function returning an age dependent odds ratio adjusting baseline
125                 * compliance probability.
126                 *
127                 * @return A function returning an age dependent odds ratio adjusting
128                 *         baseline compliance probability
129                 */
130                @Scale(Scale.ScaleType.ODDS)
131                DIST getComplianceProbability();
132
133                /**
134                 * A function returning an age dependent odds ratio adjusting baseline
135                 * contact probability.
136                 *
137                 * @return A function returning an age dependent odds ratio adjusting
138                 *         baseline modify contact odds
139                 */
140                @Scale(Scale.ScaleType.ODDS)
141                DIST getContactProbability();
142
143                /**
144                 * A function returning an age dependent odds ratio adjusting baseline
145                 * maximum social contact reduction achievable under behavioural
146                 * interventions.
147                 *
148                 * @return A function returning an age dependent odds ratio adjusting
149                 *         baseline maximum contact reduction
150                 */
151                @Scale(Scale.ScaleType.ODDS)
152                DIST getMaximumSocialContactReduction();
153        }
154
155        /**
156         * Age dependent values in the in-host Markov model configuration.
157         *
158         * <p>
159         * These entries are used by Markov-style in-host implementations to
160         * parameterise durations and time-scales.
161         *
162         * @param <DIST>    the type used to represent distribution-like adjustments
163         *                  (for example a function or empirical distribution)
164         * @param <NUMERIC> the type used to represent numeric adjustments (for
165         *                  example a simple scalar or a function that produces a
166         *                  numeric value)
167         */
168        @SuppressWarnings("immutable")
169        public interface Markov<DIST, NUMERIC> {
170                /**
171                 * A function returning an age dependent multiplicative factor applied to
172                 * immune waning half-life.
173                 *
174                 * @return A function returning an age dependent multiplicative factor
175                 *         immune waning half-life
176                 */
177                @Scale(Scale.ScaleType.FACTOR)
178                DIST getImmuneWaningHalfLife();
179
180                /**
181                 * A function returning an age dependent multiplicative factor applied to
182                 * incubation period.
183                 *
184                 * @return A function returning an age dependent multiplicative factor
185                 *         applied to incubation period
186                 */
187                @Scale(Scale.ScaleType.FACTOR)
188                DIST getIncubationPeriod();
189
190                /**
191                 * A function returning an age dependent multiplicative factor applied to
192                 * infectious duration.
193                 *
194                 * @return A function returning an age dependent multiplicative factor
195                 *         applied to infectious duration
196                 */
197                @Scale(Scale.ScaleType.FACTOR)
198                DIST getInfectiousDuration();
199
200                /**
201                 * A function returning an age dependent multiplicative factor applied to
202                 * symptom duration by age.
203                 *
204                 * @return A function returning an age dependent multiplicative factor
205                 *         applied to symptom duration
206                 */
207                @Scale(Scale.ScaleType.FACTOR)
208                DIST getSymptomDuration();
209
210        }
211
212        /**
213         * Age dependent values in the in-host phenomenological model configuration.
214         *
215         * <p>
216         * These entries adjust time-scales used by phenomenological in-host models
217         * such as incubation and recovery delays.
218         *
219         * @param <DIST>    the type used to represent distribution-like adjustments
220         *                  (for example a function or empirical distribution)
221         * @param <NUMERIC> the type used to represent numeric adjustments (for
222         *                  example a simple scalar or a function that produces a
223         *                  numeric value)
224         */
225        @SuppressWarnings("immutable")
226        public interface Phenomenological<DIST, NUMERIC> {
227                /**
228                 * A function returning an age dependent multiplicative factor applied to
229                 * immune waning half-life.
230                 *
231                 * @return A function returning an age dependent multiplicative factor
232                 *         applied to immune waning half-life
233                 */
234                @Scale(Scale.ScaleType.FACTOR)
235                DIST getImmuneWaningHalfLife();
236
237                /**
238                 * A function returning an age dependent multiplicative factor applied to
239                 * incubation period.
240                 *
241                 * @return A function returning an age dependent multiplicative factor
242                 *         applied to incubation period
243                 */
244                @Scale(Scale.ScaleType.FACTOR)
245                DIST getIncubationPeriod();
246
247                /**
248                 * A function returning an age dependent multiplicative factor applied to
249                 * delay from peak viral load to recovery.
250                 *
251                 * @return A function returning an age dependent multiplicative factor
252                 *         applied to peak-to-recovery delay
253                 */
254                @Scale(Scale.ScaleType.FACTOR)
255                DIST getPeakToRecoveryDelay();
256        }
257
258        /**
259         * An empty partial adjustment that applies no demographic modification.
260         *
261         * <p>
262         * Used as a default when no age-dependent adjustments are required.
263         */
264        PartialDemographicAdjustment EMPTY = PartialDemographicAdjustment.builder()
265                .build();
266
267        /**
268         * A sensible default set of age-dependent adjustments used in examples and
269         * tests.
270         *
271         * <p>
272         * This partial provides example functions for contact probability, clinical
273         * severity and immune waning that are suitable for demonstrations and unit
274         * tests.
275         */
276        PartialDemographicAdjustment AGE_DEFAULT = PartialDemographicAdjustment
277                .builder()
278                .setContactProbability(
279                        ImmutableEmpiricalFunction.builder()
280                                .setX(0, 5, 15, 25, 45, 75)
281                                .setY(2, 1, 1.5, 1.25, 0.8, 1.2)
282                                .setLink(LinkFunction.LOG)
283                                .build()
284                )
285                .setAppUseProbability(FixedValueFunction.ofOne())
286                .setComplianceProbability(FixedValueFunction.ofOne())
287                .setMaximumSocialContactReduction(FixedValueFunction.ofOne())
288                .setIncubationPeriod(FixedValueFunction.ofOne())
289                .setPeakToRecoveryDelay(
290                        ImmutableEmpiricalFunction.builder()
291                                .setX(0, 5, 15, 25, 45, 65)
292                                .setY(1, 0.5, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 2)
293                                .setLink(LinkFunction.LOG)
294                                .build()
295                )
296                .setImmuneWaningHalfLife(
297                        ImmutableEmpiricalFunction.builder()
298                                .setX(0, 5, 15, 25, 45, 65, 85)
299                                .setY(1, 2, 2, 1.5, 1, 0.5, 0.25)
300                                .setLink(LinkFunction.LOG)
301                                .build()
302                )
303                .setCaseHospitalisationRate(
304                        ImmutableMathematicalFunction.builder()
305                                // baseline 45, doubles every 15 years of age
306                                .setFXExpression("(x-45)/15*lg(2)")
307                                .setLink(LinkFunction.LOG)
308                                .setMinimum(0)
309                                .setMaximum(120)
310                                .build()
311                )
312                .setCaseFatalityRate(
313                        ImmutableMathematicalFunction.builder()
314                                // baseline 45, doubles every 10 years of age
315                                // this is log odds as expressed here:
316                                .setFXExpression("(x-45)/10*lg(2)")
317                                .setLink(LinkFunction.LOG)
318                                .setMinimum(0)
319                                .setMaximum(120)
320                                .build()
321                )
322                .setAsymptomaticFraction(
323                        ImmutableMathematicalFunction.builder()
324                                // baseline 45, odds halves every additional 20 years of age
325                                // this is log odds as expressed here:
326                                .setFXExpression("-(x-45)/20*lg(2)")
327                                .setLink(LinkFunction.LOG)
328                                .setMinimum(0)
329                                .setMaximum(120)
330                                .build()
331                )
332                .build();
333
334}
